Name: More Wild Berries
Author: MelindaC
Description:
[size=4]Regarding the 1.6 Update:[/size]

"More Wild Berries" [u]will[/u] be updated to 1.6 but with a few changes:

Artisanal Soda Makers will no longer be required
Better Artisan Goods Icons will no longer be required (I will add context tags for colour instead and let the game coding do the rest).
I will be adding berry bushes for Boysenberries and Marionberry for those who want to cultivate them instead. (Note there's no berry bushes for Wild Blueberry since they are not cultivated). Seed maker support would be added for those who wish to make more berry bushes without spending more money.
Any general inquiries are welcome but please note that there's no 1.6 support at the moment.

[size=4]Overview:[/size]

"More Wild Berries" is a mod that allows you to forage for boysenberries, marionberries and wild blueberries from bushes thanks to Bush Bloom Mod. You can also turn them into syrups and sodas thanks to Artisanal Soda Makers. 

While doing research on sodas for Fizzy Drinks, I sometimes comes out items that would fit the mod but don't have the mechanics or modding capabilities to implement. Bush berries were one of them. Thanks to Bush Bloom Mod and its configurative options this is now possible.

Boysenberries, a cross between a raspberry and a blackberry and mostly found wild in southern California, is available for picking in late spring and early summer. It is mostly used as preserves though a boysenberry soda is also available. This mod has the boysenberries available in Summer 3-7.

The Marionberry, a type of blackberry, were developed in the 1950s from a natural breeding program and mostly found wild in Oregon. It's a summer berry. It is mostly used in preserves and sodas. This mod has the marionberry season in Summer 23-27.

The Wild Blueberry is the wild cousin of the cultivated highbush variety but is smaller, sweeter and more nutritious. High in fibre and antioxidants, the wild blueberry played an important role in eastern Canada particularly Nova Scotia- the vast majority of frozen wild blueberries you may find in stores come from this province or Quebec. Unlike the other two berries, the wild blueberry has never been cultivated and is used in many different forms from preserves to syrups and drinks and much more. The wild blueberry season is from late summer to early fall. This mod has the wild blueberry available in Fall 2-6.

To see what the bushes and items look like, please check out the Images section.

[size=4][b][u]Requirements:

[/u][/b][/size]You are required to install the following:

-Artisanal Soda Makers
-Bush Bloom Mod
-Content Patcher
-Json Assets
-Khadija's Recipe Shop (optional)
-Producer Framework Mod
-Shop Tile Framework (optional)

Khadija's Recipe Shop is a custom shop mod made by the author of Artisanal Soda Makers to sell their items and recipes though it does support many other JA mods as well. It's also easy to add custom items as well. For more information, check out their page. Shop Tile Framework is required to run KRS and  documentation on it can be found on its page.

[size=4][b][u]Installation:

[/u][/b][/size]-First make sure you have all the required mods and that they are up-to-date.
-Download the mod and extract the folders and place them in the Mods folder.
-If you installed the entire mod pack into the Mods folder, delete it after extracting the pack folders. That's it!

[size=4][b][u]Compatibilities:

[/u][/b][/size]-More Wild Berries are compatible with other BBM mods such as Huckleberry Season and Wildflour's Wild Forage Expansion. Berries may be mixed but should still be forageable.
-Mods that affect bush foraging such as Auto Shaker, Artifact Digger and Deluxe Grabber Redux. Make sure that the berry picking options are turned on if you want to make berry foraging easier.
-There should be no conflict with any other JA or PFM mods but let me know if there is.

[size=4][b][u]Troubleshooting:

[/u][/b][/size]-First make sure that you have all the required mods and that they are up to date.
-If using a retexture mod such as Simple Foliage, make sure that all bush properties including tilesheets are turned OFF as the berries will not appear.
-If using MARGO and notice berry bushes disappearing after picking, please update Bush Bloom Mod. This problem have already been fixed. Ditto for tea bushes and golden walnut bushes as well.
-If you have any issues related to this mod, please let me know. Any issues involving other mods should be directed to the author or official Stardew Valley or Nexus Stardew Valley forums.

[size=4][b][u]Uninstallation:
[/u][/b][/size]
-Make sure you have gotten rid of all items from this mod or the game may crash.
-Delete the four pack folders from the Mods folder. That's it!

[size=4][b]Happy Berry Picking![/b][/size]
